mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_PW, AUTHORITY FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND AUTHORITY = 2 AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "MEMBER" WHERE MEMBER_EMAIL = #{memberEmail} AND AUTHORITY = 2
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "MEMBER" VALUES(SEQ_MEMBER_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberEmail}, #{memberPw},#{memberNickname}, #{memberTel}, NULL, NULL, DEFAULT, DEFAULT, 2 )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NICKNAME, MEMBER_TEL FROM "MEMBER" WHERE AUTHORITY = 2 AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N'

SELECT T.BOARD_NAME "boardName", B.BOARD_NO "boardNo", B.BOARD_TITLE "boardTitle", B.READ_COUNT "readCount", M.MEMBER_NICKNAME "memberNickname" FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "MEMBER" M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN "BOARD_TYPE" T ON B.BOARD_CODE = T.BOARD_CODE WHERE READ_COUNT = (SELECT MAX(READ_COUNT) FROM "BOARD") ORDER BY BOARD_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT T.BOARD_NAME "boardName", B.BOARD_NO "boardNo", B.BOARD_TITLE "boardTitle", B.READ_COUNT "readCount", M.MEMBER_NICKNAME "memberNickname", LC.LIKE_COUNT "likeCount" FROM "BOARD" B JOIN ( SELECT BOARD_NO, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM "BOARD_LIKE" GROUP BY BOARD_NO ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BOARD_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) LC ON B.BOARD_NO = LC.BOARD_NO JOIN "MEMBER" M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN "BOARD_TYPE" T ON B.BOARD_CODE = T.BOARD_CODE
SELECT MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_EMAIL, MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY MEMBER_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE "MEMBER" SET MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'N' WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND MEMBER_DEL_FL = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT T.BOARD_NAME "boardName", B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TITLE, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "BOARD_TYPE" T ON B.BOARD_CODE = T.BOARD_CODE JOIN "MEMBER" M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_DEL_FL = 'Y' ORDER BY B.BOARD_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET BOARD_DEL_FL = 'N' WHERE BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND BOARD_DEL_FL = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT T.BOARD_NAME AS "boardName", B.BOARD_NO AS "boardNo", B.BOARD_TITLE AS "boardTitle", B.READ_COUNT AS "readCount", M.MEMBER_NICKNAME AS "memberNickname", COUNT(C.COMMENT_NO) AS "commentCount" FROM "BOARD" B JOIN "MEMBER" M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO JOIN "BOARD_TYPE" T ON B.BOARD_CODE = T.BOARD_CODE LEFT JOIN "COMMENT" C ON B.BOARD_NO = C.BOARD_NO GROUP BY T.BOARD_NAME, B.BOARD_NO, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.READ_COUNT, M.MEMBER_NICKNAME ORDER BY "commentCount" DESC, B.BOARD_NO DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
